name: Kulturflohmarkt Museum der Arbeit

rhythm.de: Siebenmal im Jahr, von Ostermontag bis zum 3. Oktober
rhythm.en: Seven times a year, from Easter Monday to 3 October

facts: seven times a year; the season opens on Easter Monday and closes on 3 October
around the Museum der Arbeit, from Barmbek station to the Osterbek canal
flea market, no new goods: junk, second-hand and household goods
sold from tables and clothes rails only, nothing laid on the ground
leftover pitches given out on site 07:00–09:00
notes: Only one date left in the window: Sat 3 Oct 2026, the season finale (listed on the market page and the organiser's dates list; trader pitches already sold out). Next season starts Easter Monday 2027, no 2027 dates published yet. Entry fee not stated.

description.de: Siebenmal im Jahr, von Ostermontag bis zum Tag der Deutschen Einheit, jeweils von 9 bis 16 Uhr rund ums Museum der Arbeit zwischen Bahnhof Barmbek und Osterbekkanal. Trödel, Second-Hand und Hausrat, keine Neuware; verkauft wird nur von Tischen und Kleiderständern.
description.en: Seven times a year, from Easter Monday to 3 October, from 9 to 4 around the Museum der Arbeit between Barmbek station and the Osterbek canal. Junk, second-hand and household goods, no new stock, all sold from tables and clothes rails.
